snippet.description:
UPSC preparation is not about giving equal time to every subject—it is about knowing what deserves more attention.

In UPSC Mains Economy, a significant number of questions can be linked to Agriculture, which is why Agriculture needs to be covered with the depth and importance it deserves.

At LevelUp IAS Mentorship Program (LMP), preparation is planned around the actual weightage and importance of different subjects and topics. Instead of leaving aspirants to figure out what to study and how much time to spend on it, mentors provide targeted assignments based on high-priority areas and topics from which questions are frequently asked.

This helps you:

Prioritise topics based on UPSC demand
Spend more time on high-weightage areas
Cover important topics in greater depth
Follow a structured self-study plan through targeted assignments
Avoid wasting time trying to study everything equally

The right mentorship doesn't just tell you what to study. It tells you what deserves MORE of your time.

Discover how LevelUp IAS Mentorship Program brings structure, prioritisation and accountability to your UPSC preparation.
